messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-p95/p99-detector triggered for service=redwood-runtime region=us-west-2. p95 spiked to 720ms (+210%), p99 to 2.3s. Streams showing increased stalls. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:

mike_sre: saw this too on the dashboard. p95 jump started ~5m ago. looks correlated with a spike in active streams and small kernel failures on some GPUs. link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/latency/realtime?orgId=1

jess_oncall: i’m paged, taking it. initial quick checks: are we seeing errors or just latency? anyone have request ids for streaming stalls?

sara_prod: intermittent 504s for chunked responses and stalled chunking. customer-impact: a handful of small customers (session-based chat) reported frozen responses, no errors in API but client-side timeouts. will escalate if sustained.

mike_sre: i grabbed a couple of sample trace ids: trace_id=tr_7f3a2c and tr_7f3a8d. logs show long wait on kvcache fetch on node gpu-12 and a few rt kernel timeouts.

ben_infra: looks like gpuserver-12 is seeing high CUDA memcpy stalls. checking host metrics now.

jess_oncall: micro-checks i'll run: curl to streaming endpoint for a small prompt, and tail recent logs.

jess_oncall: ```curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream```

jess_oncall: test shows chunk streaming stalls after ~1s, then recovers after 6s. consistent with p99 behavior.

mike_sre: quick mitigation ideas: 1) route traffic off gpu-12 and drain, 2) force fallback to smaller model variant for streaming routes, 3) disable auto-batching for affected pool to reduce tail. which do we prefer for now?

ben_infra: i can cordon gpu-12 and move its instances to maintenance. but draining will take ~2-3m to finish inflight.

sara_prod: for customer impact mitigation, can we enable automatic retry/client-side hint with shorter chunk sizes? Not ideal mid-incident. prefer infra fix + model fallback.

mike_sre: tagging customers for immediate workaround: redirect them to dedicated endpoint with lower latency model (model:rw-light-v1) while we remediate. Can we flip routing rule?

jess_oncall: i’ll take routing. flipping canary to route 30% to rw-light-v1 for streaming routes, and enable graceful fallback. doing now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: ROUTE CHANGE: Added traffic rule id=rt-70845-canary -> rw-light-v1 (30%). Propagating to edge.

mike_sre: confirming metrics — p95 dropped from 720ms -> 380ms for traffic hitting rw-light-v1, overall system p95 now 420ms. p99 still ~1.9s but trending down.

jess_oncall: ben, you ok to cordon gpu-12 now?

ben_infra: cordon started. command:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpuserver-12 && kubectl drain gpuserver-12 --ignore-daemonsets --timeout=180s
```

ben_infra: drain in progress, 3 pods remaining. one pod needed a force-delete for stuck termination (evict failed due to active streams). took care of it by shifting sessions to the canary.

mike_sre: good. also increased autoscaler target for dedicated pool by +20% to absorb spike.

jess_oncall: telemetry looks better. no new customer reports in last 6m. p95 around baseline, p99 slowly returning to normal. I'll hold oncall and watch for 15m.

sara_prod: we should notify affected customers with note: transient streaming stalls, we rerouted traffic to lower-latency variant; engineering is investigating. draft message ready, pinging comms.

incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff required if this continues past 30m. Paging schedule: next oncall = mike_sre at 7084503420.

mike_sre: for next steps (post-incident): 1) dig into CUDA memcpy stalls on gpuserver-12, kernel/log correlation; 2) evaluate kvcache hot-keying for streaming workloads; 3) add regression alert for streaming chunk lag to detect earlier.

jess_oncall: logging a short incident ticket and marking customers impacted. will capture timeline and mitigation steps. assigning owners: infra->ben_infra, runtime->mike_sre, product->sara_prod.

jess_oncall: closing incident channel for now — will keep watch. final status: mitigated (route canary + cordon). follow-up required: RCA within 48h. :white_check_mark:
